prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PETOPIA Phase 1 game art direction board, landscape 3:2, high quality pixel art. Create a coherent professional game concept sheet with a narrow cream title header reading 'PETOPIA' and subtitle 'Phase 1 • Little Friends, Big Adventures'. Four carefully composed panels, not a busy infographic. Top left large panel: 'MY PET • HOME' showing a cozy side-view wooden cottage room with bowl, cushioned bed, washing tub, sunny window, a ball, a rug, plants. Foxy is an orange fox with huge ears, white cheeks and white tail tip, curious and playful. One curly dark-haired child explorer with warm brown skin, green jacket, blue shorts, boots and compact ochre backpack gently feeds Foxy. Crisp screen UI has Food, Happy, Energy, Clean meters, coin indicator, large Feed Clean Play Rest toolbar, no premium gems. Top right large panel: 'THE LOST PICNIC • GREEN MEADOWS' showing the SAME explorer and fox at same gameplay scale in a true side-scrolling 2D meadow with layered blue hills, wildflowers, distant windmill, shallow stream, wooden bridge and child-operated crank. Foxy's perked ears and small sparkle reveal a soft-ground cache; a clear longer grassy path bypasses the cache toward a wicker picnic basket. Three small adventure hearts, coin count, tiny 'Return the picnic basket' goal. No combat, no enemies, no Mario blocks. Bottom left small panel: 'OUR LITTLE TEAM' with explorer front and side and Foxy baby and child side silhouettes labeled Baby and Child: baby round head small body short fluffy tail; child longer legs bigger distinctive fuller tail, NOT just scaled. Four color palette swatches and simple grounded pixel proportions. Bottom right small panel: 'CATCH THE BALL' showing same Foxy playing with a ball, broad catch zone and one large Catch button, warm accessible UI. All panels share one consistent original modern pixel art style: deliberate visible square pixel clusters, 16px terrain visual rhythm, character around 40px world height, gentle forest-green, warm orange, sky-blue, cream and timber palette. Beautiful layered environments, readable generous spaces, warm children's game ages5-12. Layout should feel like actual buildable gameplay screenshots with a compact character design strip, not a marketing poster. Keep all text sparse, accurate, large and legible. Original PETOPIA identity. Avoid photorealistic, 3D, tiny text, elaborate HUD, egg stage, combat, huge unrelated characters, full roster or 15 worlds; this is a Phase1 concept proposal, not a claim of shipped features.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PETOPIA visual direction comparison for approval, landscape1536x1024, TWO clearly different equally polished pixel-art palettes side by side. This is an art direction sheet, not marketing poster, not a finished game screenshot. Take from supplied reference ONLY the idea of warm approachable cute pixel-adventure gameplay. The prior busy, oversaturated castle panorama and flat dark logo were rejected. Primary request: let the user compare two substantially different BEAUTIFUL, COHERENT, PROFESSIONAL, CLEAN pixel-art directions applied to identical game content. Visible large square pixel clusters, crisp shapes and controlled palettes, no painterly microdetail, no blurred gradients, no highfrequency texture. EXACT layout: two equal-width columns; small header labels 'A · SUNLIT STORYBOOK' and 'B · CLEAR SKY ADVENTURE'. Each column has TWO LARGE landscape actual gameplay-like vignettes, an adventure above and a home below, plus a small explorer/Foxy silhouette strip at bottom. IDENTICAL composition, character identity, room objects and terrain geometry in both columns so only color and rendering treatment differ. ADVENTURE: true side view2D platforming screen, foreground grassy platform, low log, child actively running/jumping toward a small wooden bridge over a narrow stream, Foxy actively following; wicker picnic basket on far bank and small crank; distant simple windmill, only two softly shaped hilllayers, open sky with two clouds. No ornate castle, no city, no mountains, no islands, no gigantic tree framing, no cluttered foliage, no scenic back-facing duo, no combat or famous game props. Child readable about40pixels high at native worldscale, warm brown skin, dark curlyhair, green jacket, ochre compact backpack, blueshorts, brownboots. Foxy orange white-tipped fox, huge ears, creamcheeks/chest, playful confident silhouette. Child and pet are the sharpest/highest-contrast elements, scenery subordinate. Tiny three-heart HUD and coin indicator with plenty of breathingroom. HOME: warm approachable small cottage single-room sideview, open central floor, window, cushionedbed, bowl, tub, ball, one rug, one plant; child facing Foxy feedingit, four broad simpletoolbar buttons labeled Feed Clean Play Rest. Palettes genuinely DIFFERENT: A Sunlit Storybook = warm ivory light, honeywood, soft sage and moss greens, muted teal sky, apricotorange Foxy, gentle peach accents, relaxed storybook warmth, stronger dark neutral outlines around characters only; still colorful, never brown/muddy. B Clear Sky Adventure = airy cool lightblue sky, fresh mint and emerald foliage, clean golden grass accents, light birchwood home, vivid tangerine Foxy with small coral accents, clean navy selective outlines, lively confident joyful fresh palette, never neon. Carefully limited harmonious palette in each; no rainbow clutter or excessive saturation. Bottom strip each has same explorer front and side and Foxy baby and child: distinct proportions and fuller childtail, not scaling. Keep text minimal and correctly spelled. No new logo choices: tiny unobtrusive wooden PETOPIA wordmark only if needed. Overall designer-quality neat sheet focused on comparing colors and playable composition. Friendly, magical, original world for children5–12. Do not imply all these screens are implemented.

Sparse UI, refined framing, not poster or infographic. PRIMARY SCREEN: 'Green Meadows · The Lost Picnic' actual side-scrolling RUN-AND-JUMP PLATFORM ADVENTURE screen. Compose as a gameplay camera: side-view horizontal, landscape, no angled isometric view. Main child and Foxy small about1/8 screenheight centerleft, actively crossing broad grass-topped dirt platforms over a shallow lively stream; child midjump toward lowerwoodenplanks while Foxy follows over safeground, not looking away into a vista. Original lush layered meadows with reference-like pixel grass edges, wildflowers, scattered stones, distant smallwindmill, treecanopy accents at edges. Broad lower mainroute continues across a child-operated crankbridge and clear steppingplanks, a short optional upper grassledge with soft-ground sparkle/treasure trail accessible to Foxy, and visible wickerbasket near rightedge goal. A small friendly flag checkpoint on the safe rightbank. No enemycombat, no questionmark blocks, no boss. Game pixels and foreground depth should match image2 GreenMeadows panel and image1 level examples very closely. HUD: three redpixelhearts upperleft, goldcoinicon and '12' upperright, small creamobjective badge 'Find the picnic basket'. Bottomleft small translucentrounded left/right touchcontrols, bottomright matching 'Jump', 'Use', and foxpaw 'Sense'. Focus on adventurous movement, readable leveldesign, joyful discovery and child/pet cooperation. No gigantic logo, no textdocument, no invented architecture.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this PETOPIA gameplay concept. It must visibly be standing on leftbank ground, not in the water. Keep the bridge planks across stream, checkpoint rightbank, child/fox designs and poses, picnicbasket, coin locations, colorful crisp pixel-art style, HUD, all text, touchbuttons and background unchanged. Remove the old right-side gear after relocation; a simple connected rope/shaft may indicate crankoperatesbridge. Do not invent new mechanics or change framing.
